cases.description: An open enclosure with standoffs for a small board.

messages.content: An open-top enclosure for a 65 by 30 mm circuit board: 2 mm walls and a 2 mm floor, 3 mm of clearance around the board on every side, 20 mm tall overall, with four 6 mm diameter, 5 mm tall standoffs on the floor inside, 58 by 23 mm apart and centred, each with a 2.5 mm hole.
A mount for a 40 mm fan: a 40 by 40 by 4 mm plate with a 38 mm hole in the centre, four 3.4 mm screw holes on a 32 mm square, and 3 mm rounded corners.

cases.description: Edit the fan mount: thicker, with a tab, keeping the fan holes.

messages.content: Make the plate 6 mm thick and add a 10 mm wide, 20 mm long tab sticking out from the middle of one side, as thick as the plate, with a 4 mm hole in it for screwing the mount to a frame. Keep the fan holes and rounded corners.

cases.current_code:
plate_size, thickness = 40.0, 4.0
fan_hole, screw_hole, screw_pitch, corner = 38.0, 3.4, 32.0, 3.0
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(plate_size, plate_size, thickness, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    register_feature("plate", "Plate", "additive", part.part, parameters={"size": plate_size, "thickness": thickness})
    fillet(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), radius=corner)
    register_feature("corners", "Rounded corners", "fillet", part.part, parent_id="plate", parameters={"radius": corner})
    with Locations((0, 0, thickness)):
        Hole(radius=fan_hole / 2)
        with GridLocations(screw_pitch, screw_pitch, 2, 2):
            Hole(radius=screw_hole / 2)
    register_feature("fan_holes", "Fan holes", "subtractive", part.part, parent_id="plate", parameters={"pitch": screw_pitch})
result = part.part

cases.description: A phone stand with an angled back.

messages.content: A phone stand: a 70 mm wide, 80 mm deep, 6 mm thick base, a 6 mm thick back support 70 mm wide and 90 mm long that leans back at 70 degrees from the base, starting 20 mm from the front edge, and a 10 mm tall, 4 mm thick lip along the front edge of the base to hold the phone.
